note: RER canon for the Rail Profiles page, tools/make_rer_profile_lines.py and railsim/metro_profile.py (Ben's rulings). RER-n is TRI by KMZ colour: 1 A, 2 B, 3 C, 4 D, 5 E. modes: station 'under' or 'surface' (at grade); fixed: station rail level, 'abs' metres NAVD88 or 'off' metres from ground; sections: canon structure between two stations (m: covered = covered way, cut and cover; deep = deep bore); deck: rail at yard level under a deck, ground = DEM top minus 'drop'. rivers: bed 'dem' = the canon riverbed in the ground raster, else pool minus bed_below_pool_m (no survey); every crossing in tunnel is a sunk double-track box (Ben, 30 October): rail bed - 11.6 to bed - 3.6 m (RER), bed - 10.0 to bed - 2.0 m (Metro), the lower limit on the flat bottom only; navigable: 12 ft of clear water at normal pool over a raised roof; a range along an embanked covered way (not in_covered_way) is the shore, not a crossing. 2026-10-26 (Ben): the Union Terminal box is one level for A, B and D (135.7 m); B and D run on the north viaduct (Northside 162.5, Arlington 165.9, Camp Washington 165.2 m) into the Straight box (151.64 m) and the bores to Western; the yard-level deck under the boulevard is gone. 2026-10-27 (Ben): the RER profiles are now the trunk and each branch of the lettered lines (A-E) from the Mill Creek Deck, to the region edge (D to Miamitown South); canon moved from RER-1..5 to them by station name and, for locked stretches, by position. RER_1..RER_5: the old cores' canon, kept for the railsim configs that still run on them (the page lists only the trunks and branches).
